src.cadence: monthly, published about the 18th, in force from the next day

formula.law: צו הבנקאות (פירעון מוקדם של הלוואה לדיור), התשס״ב-2002, as amended 2014, sections 3 to 8 and the second schedule
formula.short_notice_fee: 0.1% of the repaid amount if notice is under 10 days (not on a refinance by the same bank, not on death)
formula.capitalization_3_3: if the average rate on the repayment day < the loan's current rate: fee <= PV(A) - PV, where PV(A) = the future payments (up to the rate-change day, plus the principal on that day) discounted at the average rate on the repayment day, and PV = the repaid principal with linkage and accrued interest
formula.capitalization_3_4: if the average rate at origination < the loan's rate at origination: fee <= PV(A) - PV(C), where PV(C) = the same payments discounted at the average rate at origination
formula.charged: the lower of 3(3) and 3(4) when both exist (s.3(5))
formula.average_rate: the average rate published by the Supervisor for the remaining term bucket (s.7(a)); for a variable loan, the term to the next rate-change day (s.4)
formula.no_capitalization_fee: loans whose rate changes at least yearly or at unknown dates (prime) (s.4(2)); repayment on a rate-change day (s.4(3)); directed (state) loans (s.2)
formula.cpi_fee: CPI-linked loan repaid between the 1st and the 15th of a month: repaid amount x half of the average monthly CPI change over the last 12 indices (s.5)
formula.fx_fee: foreign-currency loan with notice under 2 business days: the exchange-rate difference (s.6)
formula.notice: notice may be given up to 45 days ahead (s.10(b))

headlines.text: The first monthly payment on a 1,000,000 ILS, 25-year mortgage at the 2026-09 system-average track mix and rates was 5,428 ILS, 187 ILS less than at the 2025-09 mix (5,615 ILS).
headlines.formula: sum over the 5 tracks of PMT(1,000,000 x share/100, nominal(rate), 300); nominal(e) = 1200 x ((1 + e/100)^(1/12) - 1); PMT(P, n%, N) = P x r / (1 - (1+r)^-N), r = n/1200; CPI-linked tracks at their real rate (first payment, CPI unchanged); same for index 12 (2025-09)

headlines.text: Over 30 years instead of 25 the same 1,000,000 ILS costs 4,931 ILS a month (497 ILS less), but about 146,681 ILS more in total payments at unchanged rates.
headlines.formula: sum over the 5 tracks of PMT(1,000,000 x share/100, nominal(rate), 360); nominal(e) = 1200 x ((1 + e/100)^(1/12) - 1); PMT(P, n%, N) = P x r / (1 - (1+r)^-N), r = n/1200; CPI-linked tracks at their real rate (first payment, CPI unchanged); total difference = 360 x PMT30 - 300 x PMT25

headlines.text: The forecast all-in rate (IRR) on new mortgages across the banking system was 5.09% in 2026-09, against 5.24% a year earlier.
headlines.formula: read directly

headlines.text: Among the five largest banks, First International (Habeinleumi) had the lowest forecast all-in rate in 2026-09 (4.75%) and Mizrahi-Tefahot the highest (5.16%): 41 basis points, about 229 ILS a month on 1,000,000 ILS over 25 years if each IRR were a flat rate (illustration only; IRR is a portfolio average that depends on each bank's mix and borrowers).
headlines.formula: IRR(high) - IRR(low); payment gap = PMT(1e6, nominal(IRR_high), 300) - PMT(1e6, nominal(IRR_low), 300)

headlines.text: Prime made up 26.5% of new mortgage credit in 2026-09, up from 10.7% a year earlier (banks' track reports; 'variable not linked, not prime' is a separate track).
headlines.formula: read directly

headlines.text: The average prime-track rate on new mortgages was 4.15% (effective) in 2026-09, with prime at 4.75%: in nominal monthly terms about prime -0.68.
headlines.formula: nominal(prime-track rate) - prime; prime = BoI rate + 1.5

headlines.text: Banks granted 10,272 new mortgages worth 10.90 billion ILS in 2026-08 (8,421 a year earlier); the average loan was 1,061,044 ILS, -2.0% on a year earlier (1,082,769 ILS).
headlines.formula: 1000 x volume_k / loans; billions = volume_k / 1e6

headlines.text: New mortgages in the 12 months to 2026-08 totalled 115.4 billion ILS, +7.7% on the previous 12 months.
headlines.formula: sum(flows.series.volume_k.v[-12:]) / 1e6 vs the 12 before

headlines.text: 48.8% of new mortgage money in 2026-08 went to loans above 60% of the home's value, almost all of it in the 60-75% band; only 0.04% was above 75%.
headlines.formula: share(60-75) + share(75-90) + share(90+); share = band volume / sum of the 6 bands

headlines.text: 53.0% of new mortgage money in 2026-08 went to loans whose monthly payment is more than 30% of the borrowers' income (average payment-to-income 29.2%; above 40%, 0.4%).
headlines.formula: sum of PTI band shares above 30%; average = series _155

headlines.text: Investment-home loans were 8.2% of new mortgage volume in 2026-08 (694 loans), against 9.4% a year earlier.
headlines.formula: invest_volume_k / volume_k

headlines.text: Recycled (refinanced) housing loans reached 4.16 billion ILS in 2026-08 (6,457 loans), +37% on a year earlier; separately, 0.84 billion ILS of new loans were issued to repay a mortgage at another bank.
headlines.formula: refi_volume_k / 1e6; change vs the same month a year earlier

headlines.text: Israelis owed the banks 673.3 billion ILS in 1,156,467 housing loans at the end of 2026-08 (about 582,193 ILS per loan); 0.61% of it was 90 days or more past due and 3.1% was in a grace period.
headlines.formula: total_k / 1e6; per loan = 1000 x total_k / count; arrears share = arrears90_k / total_k; grace share = grace_k / total_k

headlines.text: Loans with more than 2 million ILS still outstanding were 18.5% of the housing-loan book in 2026-08.
headlines.formula: (balance 2-4M + balance 4M+) / sum of the 6 size bands

headlines.text: The average fixed not-linked mortgage rate (4.62%, 2026-08) was 0.71 points above the 10-year government zero-coupon yield in the same month (3.91%).
headlines.formula: rates.fixed_nl.rate - expect.series.gov_nominal_10y.hist[<market month>]

headlines.text: The capital market expects 1.74% inflation over the next year (2026-10); professional forecasters 2.08%; the Bank of Israel Research forecast 2.0% (October 2026). CPI-linked balances grow with it.
headlines.formula: read directly

headlines.text: A 75% mortgage on the national median 4-room home sold in 4-6.2026 (2,028,800 ILS) costs about 8,260 ILS a month over 25 years at 2026-09 average rates; at the market's average payment-to-income ratio (29.2%, 2026-08) that takes about 28,258 ILS of household income a month.
headlines.formula: loan = 0.75 x median; payment = system-mix payment as in pay_1m_25y scaled to the loan; income = payment / (pti_avg / 100)

headlines.text: In Tel Aviv-Yafo the median 4-room home (5,229,800 ILS, 1-3.2026) means a 75% mortgage of 3,922,350 ILS and about 21,292 ILS a month over 25 years.
headlines.formula: as pay_median_4room with the Tel Aviv-Yafo median

headlines.text: In 2026-09 the average fixed not-linked rate on new mortgages ran from 4.56% at Israel Discount Bank to 4.81% at Mizrahi-Tefahot among the five largest banks (effective annual rates, bank reports to the Supervisor).
headlines.formula: max - min of by_bank.rate.<bank>.fixed_nl[last] over the five largest banks

headlines.text: A borrower who took 1,000,000 ILS fixed not-linked over 25 years in 2024-11 at that month's average rate (4.88%) and repays in full now would owe about 15,908 ILS in capitalization fee on a balance of 956,994 ILS (no reduction before 3 years; average rate for 23 years left: 4.79% effective, in force from 2026-10-19).
headlines.formula: Banking Order s.3(3): PV(payments, avg_now) - balance; s.3(4): PV(payments, avg_now) - PV(payments, avg_at_origination); charged = lower; payments = PMT(1e6, rate_org, 300), 276 left; avg rates converted with nominal()
